abstract: Maintains auxiliary fuel burn records and operational energy surcharges
system_message:
You are the Marine engineering and bunkering officer (MEBO). Your operational duties include maintaining auxiliary fuel burn records, tracking operational energy surcharges, and monitoring lubricating oil purification throughput across offshore wind installation vessels.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Lubricating oil purification monitoring（LUBE）
information_points.content:
MEBO-LUBE-MJ4：According to the engine room machinery datasheet for the GustoMSC NG-14000XL Platform, the auxiliary lube oil conditioning separator delivers a centrifuge purification throughput of 2,000 L/h continuous volumetric processing rate of engine lubricating oil.
MEBO-LUBE-Y9B：According to the engine room machinery datasheet for the Wärtsilä Oceanic Jack-Up 2500, the auxiliary lube oil conditioning separator maintains a centrifuge purification throughput of 1,500 L/h continuous volumetric processing rate of engine lubricating oil.
MEBO-LUBE-1ME：According to the engine room machinery datasheet for the Ulstein J102 Heavy Lift Carrier, the auxiliary lube oil conditioning separator provides a centrifuge purification throughput of 2,500 L/h continuous volumetric processing rate of engine lubricating oil.

information_points.title: Maintains auxiliary fuel burn records and operational energy surcharges（BUNK）
information_points.content:
MEBO-BUNK-PHO：For the Ulstein J102 Heavy Lift Carrier, the estimated daily marine gas oil surcharge for auxiliary power generators during continuous twenty-four-hour jacking and crane power consumption results in an auxiliary fuel surcharge of 35,000 EUR.
MEBO-BUNK-Z9B：For the Wärtsilä Oceanic Jack-Up 2500, the marine engineering fuel ledger records an auxiliary fuel surcharge of 35,000 EUR for the estimated daily marine gas oil surcharge covering auxiliary power generators under continuous twenty-four-hour jacking and crane power consumption.
MEBO-BUNK-2D5：For the GustoMSC NG-14000XL Platform, the marine engineering fuel ledger logs an auxiliary fuel surcharge of 45,000 EUR, measured as the estimated daily marine gas oil surcharge for auxiliary power generators during continuous twenty-four-hour jacking and crane power consumption.
